adjudication.rationale: In `app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb` the only explicit authorization filter added by this diff is `before_filter :ensure_logged_in, :ensure_staff` (no `ensure_admin`). Since this controller governs `EmbeddableHost` records that gate embedding via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (used by `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`) and influence category selection for auto-created embedded topics (`TopicEmbed.import` uses `eh.try(:category_id)`), it’s reasonable to flag that controller-level access is only “staff” and any stricter restriction would rely on routing constraints and/or inherited behavior not shown in the diff. That’s a concrete, diff-grounded defense-in-depth concern, but not a verifiable defect from the diff alone because we can’t see what `Admin::AdminController` or `AdminConstraint` enforce.
